tools.name: check_x402_seller
tools.description: check_x402_seller shows what happened when vet402 paid an x402 URL: whether the payment settled, whether content came back, and the transaction where vet402 recorded one. For WARN or BLOCK, read reason_codes. verified_terms holds the payTo, amount and network of the last purchase where content came

tools.name: check_my_x402_endpoint
tools.description: For x402 sellers: shows whether vet402 finds the endpoint in the catalogs it reads, what happened when vet402 paid it, and when vet402 can buy again. Pass any URL on your host. The answer covers the listings on that host as shown on the public seller page, the failure modes vet402 recorded with link

tools.name: find_x402_sellers
tools.description: Finds x402 listings whose URL or description matches query, among listings where vet402 paid and received content in the last 30 days. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint · Private data: check_x402_seller · Public sink: check_x402_seller.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_x402_seller, check_my_x402_endpoint · Private data: check_x402_seller · Public sink: check_x402_seller

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
